given: an organization with a Supervisor, Administrator, Crew member and Supply Officer

two vehicles with the same legacy position keys; one legacy checklist template bound to two slots for vehicle A, and two templates bound to one slot for vehicle B, with vehicle overrides and a known template_id order
current and future checklist versions, binding start/stop boundaries, kit-list versions, cabinet seals, open sessions and obligations with due instants after cutover
one shared kit definition and two physical instances assigned to separate vehicles
overlapping routine requirements for the same item and kit instance at one due instant across slots and checklist versions, with a known legacy template_id order
when: the organization migration runs, is replayed, and historical and post-cutover as-of reads are made
a Supervisor edits and publishes an item/placement on one vehicle and Crew, Supply Officer and Administrator attempt the same action
an item is published with no placement, inspected, then placed in a later vehicle-checklist version
a vehicle is exported, its file is edited and imported as a new vehicle; a pre-5.0 legacy file is also previewed and imported
a legacy import has an ambiguous template reference or invalid position reference
a later checklist publication, schedule-rule change or kit move creates an overlapping routine anchor
a kit is moved out of and into a sealed compartment, then the existing seal workflow is completed
the checklist and position projections are rebuilt from retained versions and events
then: each vehicle has distinct local positions and independent checklists; each old vehicle-template pair maps to one checklist and all many-to-many schedule assignments and exact interval boundaries survive without merge or per-slot duplication
future checklist versions and assignment boundaries preserve effective instants and DST resolution; no post-cutover checklist edit propagates; migration replay creates no duplicate rows
the Supervisor and Administrator may publish only for the target vehicle; Crew and Supply Officer are denied server-side and no other vehicle changes
the unplaced item remains due and inspectable under Not placed and is neither exempt nor satisfied; later placement applies only to its new version

the new import contains an independent copy of checklist content/positions and shared schedule/kit-definition references, with remapped local identifiers and no physical kits or operational history copied
the legacy file is previewed as a resolved independent checklist with no continuing template binding, or is refused atomically if ambiguous
kit identity and TIME-1a history remain intact; kit assignment changes preserve CAB-4/OQ-72 seal reliance and inspection/reseal behavior
as-of results and rebuilt projections match the retained configuration and event history

an overlapping routine anchor resolves to one requirement using schedule-slot text code-point order then stable checklist precedence, creates one obligation, and preserves the same winner across migration and replay; overlapping changes are accepted without merging checklist identities
notes: Language-neutral synthetic contract for proposed major SPEC amendment 5.0.0, issue #220; not an application test binding.
